t: You're at St Mary Abbots, a Church of England church on Kensington High Street, at the corner of Kensington Church Street. Sir George Gilbert Scott designed it. He was a prolific Gothic Revival architect who designed or altered over eight hundred buildings. Several people are buried here. The Scottish philosopher and economist James Mill wrote The History of British India. Elizabeth Inchbald was a novelist, actress and dramatist. The Italian opera composer Francesco Bianchi is here too, along with Henry Rich, Earl of Holland, a courtier executed by Parliament after fighting for the Royalists.
